description: Discrete CV source: a number from -12 to 12 is picked by button and multiplied by a level voltage

params.text: Picks the number, -12 to 12, that is multiplied by the level
The voltage one step is worth, 0.01V to 2.5V; at one twelfth of a volt the steps are semitones

inputs.text: Adds to the picked number before the multiplication, one step per volt

outputs.text: The picked number multiplied by the level

menu: Step Size — fixes the level knob at Semi, one twelfth of a volt; 0.1; Pat 32, 0.3125V; 0.5; Pat 16, 0.625V; 1; or Pat 8, 1.25V
